q:
Assertion (A): A hash value can be used to check the integrity of a downloaded file.
Reason (R): Any change in the file produces a different hash value.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
exp: Comparing the computed hash with the published hash reveals tampering because even a small change alters the hash.

q: In Diffie-Hellman key exchange with p = 11 and g = 2, Alice's secret is 3 and Bob's secret is 4. The shared secret key is
exp: A = 2³ mod 11 = 8; B = 2⁴ mod 11 = 5; key = 5³ mod 11 = 125 mod 11 = 4 (also 8⁴ mod 11 = 4).

q: A free game installer secretly opens a backdoor on the computer but does not copy itself to other files or machines. It is a
exp: A trojan masquerades as useful software and does not self-replicate.

q: In India, a registered trade mark is initially valid for
exp: Trade mark registration lasts 10 years and can be renewed indefinitely for further 10-year periods.

q: How does an Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) differ from an Intrusion Detection System (IDS)?
options: An IPS only works on hosts and an IDS only on networks
An IDS encrypts traffic and an IPS decrypts it
An IPS cannot detect attacks, it only logs them
An IPS sits inline and can actively block malicious traffic, whereas an IDS mainly alerts
exp: IDS monitors and raises alerts; IPS is placed in the traffic path and drops or blocks attacks.

q: A message DWWDFN was encrypted with a Caesar cipher using shift 3. The plaintext is
exp: Shifting each letter back by 3: D→A, W→T, W→T, D→A, F→C, N→K.

q: Under the IT Act, certifying authorities are licensed and regulated by the
exp: The CCA licenses CAs and supervises the issue of digital signature certificates.

q: In a stored (persistent) XSS attack, the malicious script is
options: Saved on the target server, for example in a comment, and served to every visitor
Present only in a link sent to one victim
Stored on the attacker's USB drive
Executed only inside the database engine
exp: Persistent XSS keeps the payload in server-side storage, so each viewer's browser runs it.

q: Which of the following is NOT provided by a digital signature on its own?
exp: A signature proves origin and integrity; the message stays readable unless it is also encrypted.

q: Which of the following is an example of the 'something you are' authentication factor?
exp: Biometrics such as fingerprints are inherence factors.

q: Which of the following is NOT protected by copyright?
options: An idea or concept as such, apart from its expression
exp: Copyright protects the expression of ideas, not ideas themselves.

q: A DMZ (demilitarised zone) in network security is
options: A separate subnet exposing public-facing servers between the Internet and the internal network
A zone where all traffic is blocked permanently
A backup site in another city
A wireless network without a password
exp: Placing web or mail servers in a DMZ limits damage to the internal LAN if they are compromised.

q: A full backup is taken on Sunday and a differential backup each night from Monday to Saturday. The system fails on Friday morning. How many backup sets are needed to restore it?
exp: Only the Sunday full backup and Thursday night's differential (all changes since Sunday) are needed.

q: How many different passwords of exactly 3 lowercase letters (a-z, repetition allowed) are possible?
The main purpose of the TLS handshake is to
options: Compress the web page before transfer
Assign an IP address to the client
Authenticate the server and agree on cipher suite and session keys
exp: The handshake verifies the server's certificate and establishes shared symmetric keys.

q: Legal recognition to electronic records under the IT Act 2000 is given in Section
exp: Section 4 gives legal recognition to electronic records, Section 2 holds definitions.

q: Malware that secretly records every key pressed by the user in order to steal passwords is
exp: Keyloggers capture keystrokes and send them to the attacker.

q: Users typing the correct URL of their bank are silently redirected to a fake site because DNS records were corrupted. This is
exp: Pharming poisons DNS or host files to redirect users, even when they type the right address.

q: The number of rounds in AES when a 192-bit key is used is
exp: AES uses 10, 12 and 14 rounds for 128, 192 and 256-bit keys respectively.

q: According to netiquette, typing an entire message in capital letters is generally regarded as
exp: All capitals is read as shouting in online communication.

q: Alice wants to send Bob a confidential message using public-key cryptography. She should encrypt it with
exp: Only Bob's private key can decrypt a message encrypted with his public key.

q: Match the attack with its description: (i) Smishing (ii) Whaling (iii) Spear phishing (iv) Pharming with (p) targets senior executives (q) fraudulent SMS (r) personalised e-mail aimed at a specific person (s) DNS redirection to a fake site.
exp: Smishing uses SMS, whaling targets big fish such as executives, spear phishing is personalised and pharming redirects via DNS.

q: A toy hash function is h(x) = x mod 11. Which pair of inputs causes a collision?
exp: 25 mod 11 = 3 and 36 mod 11 = 3, so both give the same hash; the other pairs give different values.

q: Cyber terrorism under Section 66F of the IT Act is punishable with
options: Imprisonment which may extend to life
exp: Section 66F prescribes imprisonment that may extend to imprisonment for life.

q: In disaster recovery planning, a 'hot site' is
options: An empty building with only power and space
A fully equipped alternate facility with current data that can take over almost immediately
A vault that stores backup tapes
A site used only for printing records
exp: Hot sites mirror systems and data for near-instant failover; cold sites are empty shells.

q:
Statement I: A stateful inspection firewall keeps track of the state of active connections.
Statement II: A firewall alone gives complete protection against attacks by trusted insiders.
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
exp: Statement I is true; a firewall filters traffic at the perimeter and cannot stop all insider misuse, so Statement II is false.

q: IPsec, commonly used to build VPNs, operates at which layer of the OSI/TCP-IP model?
exp: IPsec secures IP packets themselves, so it works at the network layer.

q: A disgruntled employee's program deletes the payroll database if his name is removed from the payroll list. This is an example of a
exp: A logic bomb stays dormant until a specific condition is met.

q: The national nodal agency in India for responding to computer security incidents is
exp: CERT-In (Indian Computer Emergency Response Team) handles cyber security incidents under the IT Act.

q: The science of analysing and breaking ciphers without knowing the key is called
exp: Cryptanalysis attempts to recover plaintext or keys from ciphertext.

q: Hiding a secret message in the least significant bits of an image file is called
exp: Steganography conceals the existence of the message itself.

q: In a DDoS attack the large group of compromised computers controlled remotely by the attacker is called a
exp: Bots under a command-and-control server form a botnet used to flood the victim.

q: In India, a patent is granted for a term of
options: 20 years from the date of filing
exp: Under the Patents Act, 1970 the term is 20 years from the filing date.

q: Which kind of software is available free of cost but its source code is not made available?
exp: Freeware costs nothing to use but remains proprietary with closed source.

q: The most effective programming-level defence against SQL injection is
options: Making the input text boxes longer
Relying only on client-side JavaScript validation
exp: Parameterised queries keep user data separate from SQL code, so input cannot alter the query structure.

q: For RSA with p = 7 and q = 11, which value of e is a valid public exponent?
exp: φ(n) = 6×10 = 60. e must be coprime with 60; gcd(5,60)=5, gcd(6,60)=6, gcd(15,60)=15, but gcd(7,60)=1.

q: Which of the following is NOT a type of malware?
exp: A honeypot is a decoy system used by defenders to study attackers.

q: Section 43A of the IT Act (inserted in 2008) deals with
options: Compensation when a body corporate fails to protect sensitive personal data
Cheating by personation using a computer resource
Publishing obscene material in electronic form
exp: Section 43A makes a body corporate liable to pay compensation for negligence in protecting sensitive personal data.

q: Which of the following is a passive attack?
exp: Passive attacks only observe; replay, masquerade and DoS actively alter or disrupt communication.

q: India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act was enacted in the year
exp: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act received assent in August 2023.
